seoTitle: Get Involved | Volunteer or Partner with Naya Aasha, Nepal
seoDescription: Volunteer your skills, partner with us, fundraise, or support a program. Naya Aasha works with children, people living with HIV, and families in Nepal.
title: There is more than one way to give hope.
intro: Naya Aasha is small, and that is exactly why individual contributions change what we can do. An afternoon of your time, an introduction to the right person, or a single funded scholarship all move real work forward. Tell us what you can offer and we will reply within three working days.

options.title: Volunteer your time or skills
options.text: We need tutors and mentors for children returning to school, Nepali and English writers, photographers, people to help run awareness sessions, and steady administrative help behind the scenes. Remote support is welcome. Most volunteers give a few hours a month, and everyone working directly with children or people living with HIV is screened and briefed on our safeguarding standards before they begin.

options.title: Partner with us
options.text: We work alongside schools, clinics, local government bodies, businesses, and community groups who share our standards. Partnerships might mean referral pathways for treatment, space for awareness sessions, in-kind supplies, pro bono professional services, or co-designed programs. We are a registered NGO affiliated with the Social Welfare Council, and we are glad to share our registration documents and governance details with any prospective partner.

options.title: Start a fundraiser
options.text: Schools, workplaces, and community groups can raise funds for a specific, verified need — a term of school supplies, nutrition support for a family, an emergency response. We will tell you exactly what the need costs before you start, and report back on what your fundraiser achieved once it is delivered.

options.title: Support a program
options.text: Donations go toward children's education, family and emergency assistance, and health support. We publish what we receive and how it is used, and we will never make assistance conditional on anyone agreeing to be photographed or named.
